purpose: Define OSC protocol bindings as explicit address-pattern mappings to canonical operations/values with declared type/argument schema and transport direction.

topics.name: OSC Binding
topics.purpose: Define OSC protocol bindings as explicit address-pattern mappings to canonical operations/values with declared type/argument schema and transport direction.

semantics.address_rule: OSC address/pattern is an explicit protocol selector.
semantics.target_rule: Each mapping resolves exact canonical operation/value target.
semantics.transport_rule: UDP/TCP or other OSC transport binding is declared through listener configuration.
semantics.identity_rule: OSC address is not target semantic identity.
semantics.authority_rule: Incoming OSC packet is inert input until routed through governed operation/value handling.
semantics.failure_rule: Unknown/invalid address or argument schema fails explicitly.

invariants.rule: Protocol identity, named listener instance, route/address/channel binding and domain operation identity remain separate; protocol exposure never creates semantic ownership or authorization.

hard_gates.condition: OSC packet directly executes hidden code
address string used as semantic identity
invalid address guessed to nearest target
